records.relationshipDecision: Azalea Dog Park is a named off-leash facility within the larger Azalea Park complex and already has a distinct destination record. It is not the parent park and is not a duplicate. John B. Lewis Soccer Complex is another separately named facility; its access status cannot be generalized to the rest of Azalea Park.
records.duplicateStatus: no parent duplicate found; existing Azalea Dog Park record retained as a related facility

wikimediaCommons.method: Exact-name web search plus geosearch within 10 kilometers of the current official parent coordinate
wikimediaCommons.outcome: Results were other Azalea Parks, nearby golf-course and hospital subjects, flora and wildlife, regional flood imagery, and aerial rasters. No representative exact-destination photograph was accepted.

officialSiteImages.outcome: The current City page embeds planning art, historic images, a ribbon-cutting image, flood damage, and trail mapping, but does not publish an image-specific reuse license. Credits and public display were not treated as permission, and the set is not four varied current visitor photographs.

risks: Treating the current standard-hours metadata as a reopening notice would overstate the evidence and could direct visitors into storm-closed areas.
The City GIS reference point and facility attributes are older than the current location record; use them for cross-checking, not for current availability.
ArcGIS or WordPress media hosting does not establish image reuse rights.
No private visitor data, precise visitor-location logs, paid API calls, dependencies, generated pages, or production writes are included.
